causeDetails.tagline: Every child should be able to use technology to learn, not be left behind by it.
overview: Many children grow up without ever using a computer, which makes it harder for them to find information, complete schoolwork, and prepare for the jobs of the future.
Digital Literacy for All brings computers and trained facilitators into the communities that need them most, so children can build practical skills in a safe, supported setting.

challenge.title: The digital divide holds children back
challenge.text: Without access to devices or guidance, children miss out on modern learning resources. The gap grows every year, and it is widest in communities with the fewest resources.

steps.title: Set up learning spaces
steps.description: We equip community centres and partner schools with computers and a reliable place to learn.

steps.title: Teach the essentials
steps.description: Trained facilitators lead hands-on sessions covering typing, safe internet use, and everyday digital tools.

steps.title: Connect children to learning resources
steps.description: Children learn to find educational content, practise their school subjects, and explore new interests online.

outcomes: Children gain confidence using computers and the internet
Students can complete schoolwork and research independently
Communities gain a lasting space for digital learning
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: Children in underserved communities who have little or no access to computers.

donationTiers.label: Learning materials
donationTiers.description: Helps provide learning materials for a child's digital skills sessions.

donationTiers.label: Class support
donationTiers.description: Helps run a series of facilitated computer sessions for a group of children.

donationTiers.label: Learning corner
donationTiers.description: Helps equip a community learning corner with devices and resources.

causeDetails.tagline: Curiosity grows when children get to build, test, and make things with their own hands.
overview: In many rural areas, science and technology are taught from textbooks alone, with few chances to experiment. Hands-on learning helps ideas make sense and sparks interest that lasts.
Our STEAM workshops bring practical activities in science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics to children who rarely get this kind of experience.

challenge.title: Limited hands-on learning in rural schools
challenge.text: Schools in remote areas often lack lab equipment, trained mentors, and project materials, so children have fewer chances to explore and discover their strengths.

steps.title: Bring workshops to the community
steps.description: Facilitators travel to schools and village centres with the materials needed for each session.

steps.title: Learn by making
steps.description: Children work in small teams on simple experiments, models, and creative projects.

steps.title: Encourage questions
steps.description: Each workshop ends with children presenting what they built and what they learned.

outcomes: Children develop problem-solving and teamwork skills
Students show more interest in science, technology, and the arts
Rural schools gain activity ideas and materials they can keep using
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: School-age children in rural areas with limited access to hands-on learning.

donationTiers.label: Activity kit
donationTiers.description: Helps provide materials for a child to take part in a workshop.

donationTiers.label: Workshop session
donationTiers.description: Helps run a full workshop session for a group of students.

donationTiers.label: School visit
donationTiers.description: Helps bring a series of workshops to a rural school.

causeDetails.tagline: When children can't get to books, we bring the books to them.
overview: Reading is the foundation of all other learning, yet many children live far from a library or have no books at home.
The Mobile Library Initiative travels to underserved communities with books, storytelling sessions, and learning resources, so reading becomes part of everyday life.

challenge.title: Too few books within reach
challenge.text: Children without regular access to books fall behind in reading and find it harder to enjoy learning. Distance and cost keep libraries out of reach for many families.

steps.title: Travel to the community
steps.description: The mobile library visits on a regular schedule so children know when to expect it.

steps.title: Share stories together
steps.description: Storytelling and reading sessions help children enjoy books and build confidence.

steps.title: Lend books to take home
steps.description: Children borrow books to read at home and share with their families.

outcomes: Children read more often and enjoy it
Families gain access to books and learning resources
Communities build a regular, shared reading habit
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: Children in underserved communities who live far from a library or have few books at home.

donationTiers.label: New books
donationTiers.description: Helps add new books to the mobile library collection.

donationTiers.label: Storytelling sessions
donationTiers.description: Helps fund a series of storytelling and reading sessions.

donationTiers.label: Community visits
donationTiers.description: Helps keep the library visiting a community over several months.

causeDetails.tagline: Creating something and watching it grow teaches children patience, teamwork, and pride.
overview: Art and gardening give children room to express themselves and learn through doing. They also build care for the environment and for each other.
Art & Gardening for Empowerment combines creative sessions with garden projects, helping children grow in confidence while they learn about nature.

challenge.title: Few chances for creative, outdoor learning
challenge.text: Many children have little opportunity to express themselves creatively or spend time learning outdoors. These experiences help build confidence and emotional well-being.

steps.title: Create together
steps.description: Children take part in group art sessions that encourage imagination and teamwork.

steps.title: Plant and care for a garden
steps.description: They plant seedlings, look after them, and learn how plants grow.

steps.title: Share what they've made
steps.description: Children show their artwork and garden to their families and community.

outcomes: Children gain confidence and learn to work as a team
Students develop awareness of the environment
Schools and communities gain a green space they can keep growing
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: Children who would benefit from creative and outdoor learning, including those with limited access to such activities.

donationTiers.label: Seeds and art supplies
donationTiers.description: Helps provide seeds, tools, and art materials for a child.

donationTiers.label: Group sessions
donationTiers.description: Helps run a series of art and gardening sessions for a group.

donationTiers.label: Community garden
donationTiers.description: Helps set up a garden space for a school or community.

causeDetails.tagline: A notebook and a school bag can be the difference between attending class and staying home.
overview: For many families, the cost of notebooks, stationery, and school bags is a real barrier. Children without these basics can struggle to keep up or feel left out.
School Supplies for Every Child provides essential learning materials so students can attend class prepared and focus on learning.

challenge.title: Basic supplies are out of reach for many families
challenge.text: When families can't afford school essentials, children may attend without what they need, or stop attending at all.

steps.title: Identify children in need
steps.description: We work with schools and communities to find the students who need support.

steps.title: Prepare supply kits
steps.description: Each kit includes notebooks, stationery, and a school bag.

steps.title: Hand over kits at the start of term
steps.description: Students receive their supplies so they can begin the school year ready to learn.

outcomes: Children attend class with the materials they need
Families face less financial pressure at the start of the school year
Students feel included and ready to learn
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: School-age children whose families cannot afford essential learning materials.

donationTiers.label: Stationery set
donationTiers.description: Helps provide notebooks and stationery for a child.

donationTiers.label: Full school kit
donationTiers.description: Helps provide a school bag and a full set of supplies for a child.

donationTiers.label: Classroom support
donationTiers.description: Helps provide supplies for a group of students.

causeDetails.tagline: When a girl can learn, her whole community benefits.
overview: Girls often face extra barriers to education, from limited resources to expectations that hold them back. Support and encouragement can change what feels possible.
Girls' Education & Opportunity supports girls with learning resources, mentoring, and guidance so they can pursue their educational goals with confidence.

challenge.title: Girls face extra barriers to staying in school
challenge.text: Cost, distance, and social expectations can keep girls from continuing their education, even when they are eager to learn.

steps.title: Provide learning resources
steps.description: Girls receive books, supplies, and study support to help them keep up in school.

steps.title: Offer mentoring
steps.description: Mentors guide girls in setting goals and planning the next step in their education.

steps.title: Build a supportive circle
steps.description: Group sessions bring girls together to learn, share, and encourage each other.

outcomes: More girls stay engaged in their education
Girls gain confidence and clearer goals for the future
Families and communities see the value of educating girls
causeDetails.whoWeHelp: Girls who need learning resources, mentoring, and encouragement to continue their education.

donationTiers.label: Learning resources
donationTiers.description: Helps provide books and study materials for a girl.

donationTiers.label: Mentoring support
donationTiers.description: Helps fund mentoring sessions for a group of girls.

donationTiers.label: Education support
donationTiers.description: Helps support a girl's learning needs over a longer period.
